div.head: II Atr 3.1
div.ab: Si regis Æþelredi friðmannus ueniat in unfriðland (id est in hostilem terram), et exercitus adueniat, pacem habeat nauis eius et omnis pecunia sua.
Gyf Æðelredes cynges friðman cume on unfriðland, ⁊ se here ðærto cume, hæbbe frið his scip ⁊ ealle his æhta.
Gyf Æðelredes cynges friðman cume on unfriðland ⁊ se here ðærto cume, hæbbe frið his scip ⁊ ealle his æhta.

If a subject of King Æthelred's who is included in the truce comes to a region to which it does not apply, and the aforesaid fleet arrives there, protection shall be afforded to his ship and all his goods.
If a subject of King Ethelred to whom this truce applies comes into a district where it does not apply, and the army comes there, his ship and all his goods are to enjoy peace.

Wenn ein Unterthan von König Aethelreds Friedensgebiet in ein nicht im Frieden [dieses Vertrages stehendes] Land kommt, und dieses Heer [der Nordleute] kommt ebendahin, so geniesse sein Schiff und alle seine Güter Friedensschutz [vor diesem Heere].

If a subject from King Æthelred's peace-area comes into a land not at peace [under this treaty], and this army [of the Northmen] comes there, let his ship and all his goods have protection [from this army].
